name: Dia
tagline: An AI browser that answers questions and helps you write using the tabs you have open.
about: Dia is a browser from The Browser Company with an assistant built in. You can chat with the pages you have open and get writing help in any text field.
pros: Chat with the pages and tabs you have open.
Writing help in any text field.
cons: Heavier AI use needs a paid plan.
AI features send page content to cloud models.
